china_race_dynamics.text:
It was a pleasure to speak at the @47G_Utah Summit alongside former Representative Chris Stewart about global AI competition and the role of government in this rapidly evolving field.

Thank you to @47G_Utah for bringing together leaders and keeping Utah at the forefront of these important conversations.

deepseek.reason: The statement mentions global AI competition but does not address competition with China as a policy priority.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement lacks any explicit China competition framing.

china_race_dynamics.text:
We cannot risk ceding the future of AI to China.

In @housescience I discussed how my GENESIS Act advances the @WhiteHouse’s AI Action Plan and how the federal government should empower state-level experimentation.

Utah’s regulatory sandbox has already proven this model works, and I’m committed to building on that success so we win the AI race.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the US cannot risk ceding AI to China and is committed to winning the AI race.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames China AI competition as a priority.

china_race_dynamics.text:
Today I introduced the Growth, Energy, and National Excellence through Science, Innovation, and Security Act (GENESIS Act) to codify President Trump’s newly signed Executive Order launching the Genesis Mission.

This legislation will empower the federal government to harness artificial intelligence to accelerate scientific discovery, strengthen national security, and keep America ahead in the global AI race.

deepseek.reason: The speaker introduces legislation to keep America ahead in the global AI race.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The bill text explicitly endorses staying ahead in the AI race, though China is not named.

china_race_dynamics.text: There's an arms race with artificial intelligence all over the world. [...] Washington D.C. and Congress is a meat cleaver. We need a surgical scalpel. [...] I do worry that the federal government gets too involved in these things when they don't even know what they're doing.

deepseek.reason: The speaker notes a global AI arms race but does not take a position on prioritizing competition with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement is descriptive about an arms race and criticizes federal involvement, not the China priority.

astra.reason: The speaker discusses a worldwide AI arms race and federal intervention without identifying competition with China.
astra.confidence_reason: The supplied excerpt does not connect its global arms-race language to China.
